summary: Reinsurance Group of America filed an 8-K announcing full redemption of its $400M 5.75% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Debentures due 2056 (CUSIP RZB). Redemption effective June 15, 2026 at 100% of principal plus accrued interest. No board recommendation or advisor named; redemption is mandatory under indenture terms. The notice triggers a debt reduction and lower interest expense, representing a capital return to debtholders at par. Watch for any refinancing plans or balance-sheet deleveraging signals from management; typical risk-arb is minimal as redemption is at par with no premium.
